subject.title: telegram: isolated-ingress handler-timeout dead-letters a user message silently (no reply, no replay, nothing surfaced)

question: What should Telegram isolated ingress do with handler-timeout and retry-limit failed tombstones that represent an unprocessed user message?
rationale: Current code intentionally tombstones these rows to unblock lanes, while sending a user notice or replaying zero-attempt timeout tombstones changes channel delivery semantics and duplicate-risk tradeoffs.

options.title: Notify and surface tombstones
options.body: Dead-lettered user messages remain tombstoned but enqueue a minimal recovery notice and expose durable failed-spool status to operators.

options.title: Replay handler timeouts once
options.body: Handler-timeout tombstones with zero attempts get one post-restart replay while retry-limit tombstones stay terminal.

options.title: Keep tombstone-only policy
options.body: Current behavior stays terminal and the issue closes only if maintainers accept failed-spool visibility without a user notice.

recommendation.title: Notify and surface tombstones
recommendation.body: Dead-lettered user messages remain tombstoned but enqueue a minimal recovery notice and expose durable failed-spool status to operators.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged retry-limit policy and related design issue make this the strongest available routing signal for the policy choice.
